note: Every parameter declares its evidence class and source. 'assumed' values are D-grade planning assumptions and are user-visible.

design_storm_duration_h.source: Planning assumption: 1-hour design storm for small urban ward catchments

design_return_period_basis.source: IMD 0.5 deg gridded daily rainfall 1971-2005, nearest cell to zone centroid

c_impervious.source: Rational-method coefficient for roofs/paving (0.75-0.95), standard hydrology texts (e.g. Chow, Maidment & Mays 1988)

c_pervious.source: Rational-method coefficient for urban lawns/open soil (0.10-0.35)

c_vegetated_plot.source: Rational-method coefficient for dense planting / woodland (0.05-0.25)

non_building_impervious_fraction.source: Planning assumption for roads and paving not captured by building footprints

rwh_collection_efficiency.source: Hard-roof runoff coefficient 0.75-0.90 commonly used in Indian rainwater-harvesting manuals (e.g. CGWB)

rwh_demand_m3_day.source: Planning assumption: non-potable use of a small residential block

roof_eligible_fraction.source: Planning assumption: share of detected footprint roof area screened as programme-eligible (structure, ownership, access unverified)

plantable_fraction_of_open_land.source: Planning assumption: share of non-building land that could be available public planting land (not verified)

forest_crown_fraction_avg_10y.source: Planning assumption: average crown cover over a 10-year establishment period

crown_carbon_rate_tc_ha_yr.unit: tC per ha crown cover per yr
crown_carbon_rate_tc_ha_yr.source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines Vol.4 Ch.8 (Settlements), Tier 2 crown-cover default

equity_alpha.source: Planning assumption: linear vulnerability weight on SC/ST population share

normalisation.note: Fixed reference scales tau (master plan §5.3): identical across portfolios and shocks. Each tau is the benefit of spending the default 2 crore entirely on the single best unit type for that objective in the normal scenario, computed by the engine and frozen in the baseline manifest.

priority_modes.note: Order F, W, H, G, Equity, LCC. Balanced is the master plan's full preset; for the '-first' modes the master plan fixes only the primary weight and the remaining split is the approved frontend's preset (ui/fixtures.py).
